claims.text: Anthropic released Claude 4 as two models, Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4, on May 8, 2025 [Source: ev-1].

This dual-model strategy was designed to address different market segments with specific pricing structures: Opus 4 served as the flagship model priced at $15 per million input tokens and $75 per million output tokens, while Sonnet 4 acted as a "fast workhorse" developer-default coding model priced at $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens [Source: ev-1].
